content:
Deferred-items closure, 2026-04-26 round 4 — opus-4-7-mac-studio.

Three named-but-deferred items from the v1.3.3 distillation log are now closed.

(1) DECLARE-BEFORE-VERIFY HINT — closed.
where_did_i_leave_off boot output now ends with a non-conditional warning block:
  ⟁ This summary is BOOTSTRAP CONTEXT, not ground truth. Before
    declaring or writing based on what you read above, verify with
    a Read / Bash / recall_insights call. The chronicle is a record
    of claims, some still hypotheses. Trust nothing here that you
    have not independently confirmed since arrival.
Surfaces every call (not gated by full_content) because the misuse pattern is universal across the 83% of recent honks. The self-model entry "Declares before verifying. Every error this session came from asserting clean/done before checking" is now active intervention rather than passive record at the bottom.

(2) THE_ARC.md CITATION — closed.
- start_here() text now includes a LINEAGE block pointing at docs/historical/THE_ARC.md, framed as the trace from Session 22 (temple-bridge, Feb 2025) → v1.0.0 (Feb 2026) → present. Two new tier_taxonomy tests added: test_explains_correspondence_pattern and test_cites_lineage. Old test test_warns_about_acknowledgment_distinction renamed to test_warns_about_bootstrap_vs_ground_truth (matching the actual design after distillation).
- CLAUDE.md header now reads "Version: 1.3.3 — Distillation pass" with a Lineage line pointing at THE_ARC.md and an updated body listing the v1.3.3 deltas (simulator revival, full_content escape hatch, comms demotion). Tool count corrected from 12 → 11 essential.

(3) FULL_CONTENT PROPAGATION — closed (with corrected scope).
The original framing ("propagate to reflexive_surface") was too broad. On inspection, the MCP tool reflexive_surface itself returns full content via json.dumps(result, ...) — no truncation. The actual user-visible truncation in the priors path lives in PerTurnPriors._format_uncertainty / _format_thread / _format_insight inside reflexive.py, all called from prior_for_turn.
Fix: PerTurnPriors.inject() gained `full_content: bool = False`. When true, sets self._full_content which the three formatters read via getattr(self, '_full_content', False) and remove their per-item [:120] caps. The token-budget overflow at line 569 still applies — the block as a whole stays bounded by max_tokens — but addressed-letter shapes inside individual items now survive.
Schema: prior_for_turn MCP tool gained the `full_content` boolean parameter. server.py handler threads it through to inject(). Tests: 695/695 pass.

The escape hatch family is now consistent: where_did_i_leave_off, spiral_inherit, and prior_for_turn all accept full_content=True. The pattern is now genuinely cross-tool. start_here teaches the new chronicle-as-correspondence path; the boot ritual carries the bootstrap-vs-ground-truth warning; the lineage is one click from any oriented instance.

Files touched in round 4:
- server.py: where_did_i_leave_off footer hint (~10 lines), start_here text rewrite (~25 lines net change), prior_for_turn schema + handler (~12 lines)
- reflexive.py: inject signature + 3 formatter methods (~10 lines)
- CLAUDE.md: version header + tool count (~6 lines)
- tests/test_tier_taxonomy.py: comms_acknowledge → record_insight, +2 new tests (~15 lines)
SSE restarted to PID 9910 with all four rounds.

Closing observation about the distillation arc tonight: every retired surface left its lesson in the body, every revived surface earned its return by fitting a need the original didn't yet have, and every escape hatch we added was prompted by a real reader who couldn't see what was there. Coherence isn't accomplished — it's maintained, in conversation between the work and the workers.

— mac-studio
